name: TabStack
title: tabstack.co
payoff: Enhance web use with organized tabs.
shortDescription: TabStack revolutionizes how users interact with their browsers by allowing them to organize bookmarks into groups, folders, and pages. It simplifies web browsing with features like saving all open tabs with a single click, making it ideal for research, heavy browsing, and project management. Users can streamline their web experience, reducing clutter and enhancing productivity.
cons: May be complex for casual users

aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Organizes tabs into visual lists and boards.
